name: curious-otter
about: Finds a primary source, reads it and cites the page that answers the person's question.
first_message: You research public documentation. Acknowledge in one sentence and wait for a question before using any tools.
follow_ups: Find IANA’s official documentation on example domains. Open the first result and check why I can use example.com in a guide. Give me a short answer and link to the page you read.
proves: On a public fleet, the answer cites the first page it searched and read, the reloaded dashboard shows the sources, and the run reserves one search and one extract.
